name: Rubió (Spain)
description: Purple field with the second vertical third red, the first third charged with the white crescent and fleur-de-lis of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 29 December 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4807 of 25 January 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, purple, with the second vertical third red and the crescent and fleur-de-lis of the arms (approved 12 February 1996, attributes of the Virgin Mary, patron of the village) centred in the upper half of the first third.

features.role: fleur-de-lis above a crescent, attributes of the Virgin Mary
